description: Erection of a first floor side extension and demolition of existing conservatory and erection of a single storey rear extension.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1248-P-001, 1248-P-002, 1248-P-003, 1248-P-004, 1248-P-006, 1248-P-007 - received 4th August 2021, 1148-P-005 Rev. A - received 24th September 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The first floor front window to the first floor side extension hereby approved shall be fitted with obscured glazing and be non-opening to a height of 1.7m above the internal finished floor level of the room it serves. The window shall be maintained as such in perpetuity.
